brands.name: GMK (Association of Graphic Designers in Turkey)
Kristal Elma (Crystal Apple)
brands.description:
Founded in 1988 by the Association of Advertising Agencies of Turkey, Kristal Elma is the country's oldest and most prestigious award for creative communication. For more than three decades, it has set the benchmark for excellence in Turkish advertising, recognizing outstanding work across advertising, design, digital and media.

Each year, the industry's most respected creative leaders sit on the jury and judge the entries with uncompromising standards. Winning a Kristal Elma is the highest recognition a piece of creative work can earn in Turkey. It is a mark of ideas that are bold, strategically sharp and flawlessly crafted.

For agencies, brands and creatives alike, Kristal Elma is more than an award. It is where Turkey's creative industry measures itself, celebrates its best, and raises the bar for what comes next.
